lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Hey, I was thinking we should finally plan that trip to Portugal.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Maybe in the first week of May, when the weather is nice.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I have always wanted to ride the old yellow trams through the city.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That sounds wonderful, but I need to check my work schedule first.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Do you want to start in Lisbon or in Porto?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I also heard the food in the north is incredible.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Let's start in Lisbon, and then take the train north.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Great, I will book the flights tonight, and we can talk more tomorrow.
